# Vendored reveal.js 5.1.0

`report/build.py` inlines `reveal.css` and `reveal.js` into `slides.html`, so
the deck presents with no network at all — which is the point of a file you
email to somebody.

Taken verbatim from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/reveal.js@5.1.0/dist/`.
Nothing here is edited; to move versions, re-download all three files and
rebuild.

reveal.js is MIT licensed — see `LICENSE`, included as the license requires.
